name: page view counter
description: Displays a real-time page-view count for content, updated via a lightweight JSON endpoint and per-visitor cookies, shown through a counter block.
project_description:
Page Views show the total number of times a specific webpage is loaded or reloaded in a web browser. This metric serves as an indicator of a particular page's popularity and content engagement.

 Usage: 

 
 Create Counter Block in Page . Every User visits the Page , the counter will increase . 
 Page view counter has builtin dashboard to check all page status. 
 Goto Content > Page View Counters 
 
 Steps to configure 

 
 Goto Structure > Block layout 
 Insert PVC block 
 
 Definitions:

 Max time - Time to spend on each page that will increment counter.

 Class - Classname of an element

 Prefix - Custom html element prefixed from custom block

 Suffix - Custom html element suffixed from custom block

 Out of the box feature: 

Can be integrate with views
